synbiotics may contribute to the modulation of immune function in the colon cancer model.

The main takeaway from our work is that
synbiotics (PRE + PRO) modulate the immune system in a manner that could be useful in cancer prevention.
the combination of probiotics and prebiotics (synbiotics) can have an effect on the immune system and can help to prevent the development of colon cancer.
the combination of prebiotic and probiotic may be more effective in modulating immune responses and in the inhibition of colon carcinogenesis than the individual components.
